s0301.literal: On dingsi day the moon occulted Room.
s0301.idiomatic: On dingsi day the moon occulted Room.

s0302.literal: On jiwei day the Hunting and Falconry Commissioner's Headquarters was abolished, together with the Household Registry, Zhou-use, Light-levy, and other treasuries, and the Huizhou Route silver works.
s0302.idiomatic: On jiwei day the hunting and falconry commissioner's headquarters was abolished, together with the household registry, Zhou-use, light-levy, and other treasuries, and the Huizhou Route silver works.

s0303.literal: At salt commissioner's offices in every place, salt fields were reorganized to establish commanders and vice commanders.
s0303.idiomatic: At salt commissioner's offices in every place, salt fields were reorganized to establish commanders and vice commanders.

s0304.literal: Dadu's land tax for this year was again remitted.
s0304.idiomatic: Dadu's land tax for this year was again remitted.

s0305.literal: The wine prohibition in Ganzhou was lifted.
s0305.idiomatic: The wine prohibition in Ganzhou was lifted.

s0306.literal: On gengshen day Henan Branch Secretariat had a shortfall of one hundred thousand yin of salt and five thousand ingots of notes in the annual allotment for the Two Huai; Zhala'erdai and others were dispatched to investigate the facts, with orders to punish according to the severity of the offense.
s0306.idiomatic: On gengshen day Henan branch secretariat had a shortfall of 100,000 yin of salt and 5,000 ingots of notes in the annual allotment for the Two Huai; Zhala'erdai and others were dispatched to investigate the facts, with orders to punish according to the severity of the offense.

s0307.literal: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat increased surplus salt-note revenues by more than twelve thousand five hundred ingots; Shandong Transport Commission's Biesige and others increased surplus salt-note revenues by more than four thousand ingots; each was granted garments to commend their ability.
s0307.idiomatic: Shaanxi branch secretariat increased surplus salt-note revenues by more than 12,500 ingots; Shandong transport commission's Biesige and others increased surplus salt-note revenues by more than 4,000 ingots; each was granted garments to commend their ability.

s0308.literal: The southerner Hong Youxue submitted a sealed memorial rashly discussing the Five Movements; he was flogged and sent away.
s0308.idiomatic: The southerner Hong Youxue submitted a sealed memorial rashly discussing the Five Movements; he was flogged and sent away.

s0309.literal: On renxu day Tajigu Asan was executed for complicity in wrongdoing.
s0309.idiomatic: On renxu day Tajigu Asan was executed for complicity in wrongdoing.

s0310.literal: An edict forbade branch secretariats and branch maritime trade supervisorates from levying shares on merchant-ship cargo while concealing choice goods.
s0310.idiomatic: An edict forbade branch secretariats and branch maritime trade supervisorates from levying shares on merchant-ship cargo while concealing choice goods.

s0311.literal: On wuchen day Ayachi was dispatched to verify stored grain in Koryo.
s0311.idiomatic: On wuchen day Ayachi was dispatched to verify stored grain in Koryo.

s0312.literal: Commoners of Pingyang complained that the households of Princes Xiaoxie and Qulieshibo were acting lawlessly; officials were dispatched to investigate.
s0312.idiomatic: Commoners of Pingyang complained that the households of Princes Xiaoxie and Qulieshibo were acting lawlessly; officials were dispatched to investigate.

s0313.literal: King Chen Yiji of Annam was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
s0313.idiomatic: King Chen Yiji of Annam was granted 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0314.literal: That month the river ran clear for three days along more than three hundred li above and below Lanzhou.
s0314.idiomatic: That month the river ran clear for three days along more than 300 li above and below Lanzhou.

s0315.literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, because the eldest princess of Lu was building a Buddhist temple at Yingchang, one thousand ingots of notes and fifty taels of gold were granted.
s0315.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, because the eldest princess of Lu was building a Buddhist temple at Yingchang, 1,000 ingots of notes and 50 taels of gold were granted.

s0316.literal: Maiding, He Rongzu, and others were ordered to rectify the selection regulations.
s0316.idiomatic: Maiding, He Rongzu, and others were ordered to rectify the selection regulations.

s0317.literal: On jimao day Biezhe of the Mangwu tribe was transferred to Jiangxi to follow Yuedimishi in suppressing bandits.
s0317.idiomatic: On jimao day Biezhe of the Mangwu tribe was transferred to Jiangxi to follow Yuedimishi in suppressing bandits.

s0318.literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered that each province retain only one Confucian school intendant's office; the rest were all abolished.
s0318.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered that each province retain only one Confucian school intendant's office; the rest were all abolished.

s0319.literal: Pingyang County and others in Jiangnan were promoted to prefectures.
s0319.idiomatic: Pingyang County and others in Jiangnan were promoted to prefectures.

s0320.literal: According to household count: those with forty to fifty thousand households were lower prefectures, fifty to one hundred thousand were middle prefectures; lower prefectures had five officials, middle prefectures six.
s0320.idiomatic: According to household count: those with 40,000 to 50,000 households were lower prefectures, 50,000 to 100,000 were middle prefectures; lower prefectures had five officials, middle prefectures six.

s0321.literal: In all there were twenty-eight middle prefectures and fifteen lower prefectures.
s0321.idiomatic: In all there were 28 middle prefectures and 15 lower prefectures.

s0322.literal: Because households fell short of the quota, Lianzhou Route was reduced to Lianzhou Prefecture.
s0322.idiomatic: Because households fell short of the quota, Lianzhou Route was reduced to Lianzhou Prefecture.

s0323.literal: Penalties for supplemental-note counterfeiters were increased; informants were still granted generous rewards, to be paid by the offender.
s0323.idiomatic: Penalties for supplemental-note counterfeiters were increased; informants were still granted generous rewards, to be paid by the offender.

s0324.literal: On xinsi day the Acting Ministry of Revenue was abolished.
s0324.idiomatic: On xinsi day the acting ministry of revenue was abolished.

s0325.literal: Grand councillor Maiding was promoted to grand councillor for state and military affairs; Left Vice Chancellor and deliberator of central secretariat affairs He Rongzu was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall and deliberated central secretariat affairs.
s0325.idiomatic: Grand councillor Maiding was promoted to grand councillor for state and military affairs; left vice chancellor and deliberator of central secretariat affairs He Rongzu was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall and deliberated central secretariat affairs.

s0326.literal: On jiashen day an edict ordered that all overdue taxes and grain owed before the fifth month of the first year of Yuanzhen be remitted from collection.
s0326.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered that all overdue taxes and grain owed before the fifth month of the first year of Yuanzhen be remitted from collection.

s0327.literal: On dinghai day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
s0327.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

s0328.literal: On jiawu day, because Prince Ajiji's division was impoverished, two hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0328.idiomatic: On jiawu day, because Prince Ajiji's division was impoverished, 200,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0329.literal: Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat minister Temur did not heed the edict; an official was dispatched to reprimand him.
s0329.idiomatic: Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat minister Temur did not heed the edict; an official was dispatched to reprimand him.

s0330.literal: On bingshen day Bayan's son Maide was made vice director of the military council.
s0330.idiomatic: On bingshen day Bayan's son Maide was made vice director of the military council.

s0331.literal: The empress dowager said his father had devoted himself to the royal house and wished him to succeed his father's office; the Emperor, because he was still young, made this appointment instead.
s0331.idiomatic: The empress dowager said his father had devoted himself to the royal house and wished him to succeed his father's office; the Emperor, because he was still young, made this appointment instead.

s0332.literal: An edict announced agricultural, silkworm, and waterworks matters throughout the realm.
s0332.idiomatic: An edict announced agricultural, silkworm, and waterworks matters throughout the realm.

s0333.literal: Jinchou, Xihe Prefecture, and Huizhou in Gongchang Prefecture were struck by hail; wheat and grain were destroyed.
s0333.idiomatic: Jinchou, Xihe Prefecture, and Huizhou in Gongchang Prefecture were struck by hail; wheat and grain were destroyed.

s0334.literal: Raozhou, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Huzhou, Pingjiang, Jiankang, Taiping, Changde, and Lizhou all suffered flooding.
s0334.idiomatic: Raozhou, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Huzhou, Pingjiang, Jiankang, Taiping, Changde, and Lizhou all suffered flooding.

s0335.literal: Summer, sixth month, wushen day: in Licheng County of Jinan Route the Daqing River overflowed, destroying commoners' dwellings.
s0335.idiomatic: Summer, sixth month, wushen day: in Licheng County of Jinan Route the Daqing River overflowed, destroying commoners' dwellings.

s0336.literal: On renzi day King Wang Ju of Koryo requested to be Grand Preceptor and Central Secretariat Director; this was not granted.
s0336.idiomatic: On renzi day King Wang Ju of Koryo requested to be grand preceptor and central secretariat director; this was not granted.

s0337.literal: Because of troublesome border service and flood disaster, this year's taxes for eight hundred households in Xianping Prefecture were remitted.
s0337.idiomatic: Because of troublesome border service and flood disaster, this year's taxes for 800 households in Xianping Prefecture were remitted.

s0338.literal: An edict ordered Liaoyang Province to supply twenty-four relay stations for gyrfalcon transport; each station was granted six oxen, five shi of rice for envoys' food, and five sheep for the hawks' food;
s0338.idiomatic: An edict ordered Liaoyang Province to supply 24 relay stations for gyrfalcon transport; each station was granted six oxen, five shi of rice for envoys' food, and five sheep for the hawks' food;

s0339.literal: Twelve dog-relay stations were also established; each household was granted ten ingots of notes.
s0339.idiomatic: Twelve dog-relay stations were also established; each household was granted 10 ingots of notes.

s0340.literal: On jiayin day Hanlin Chancellor Dong Wenyong and others presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Shizu.
s0340.idiomatic: On jiayin day Hanlin chancellor Dong Wenyong and others presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Shizu.

s0341.literal: On yimao day in the Jiangxi branch secretariat's jurisdictions flooding destroyed the grain crop and the people lacked food; local offices and surveillance commission officials were ordered to provide relief, and prohibitions on rivers, lakes, and ponds were lifted so the people might gather resources.
s0341.idiomatic: On yimao day in the Jiangxi branch secretariat's jurisdictions flooding destroyed the grain crop and the people lacked food; local offices and surveillance commission officials were ordered to provide relief, and prohibitions on rivers, lakes, and ponds were lifted so the people might gather resources.

s0342.literal: Yuanzhou was promoted to a route; Jingzhou was subordinated to it.
s0342.idiomatic: Yuanzhou was promoted to a route; Jingzhou was subordinated to it.

s0343.literal: Envoys were dispatched with provincial officials to transfer and assign officials of rank six and below in distant regions; the Left and Right Two Rivers pacification commissioner's headquarters and assuagement commissions were combined as the Guangxi Two Rivers Circuit pacification commissioner's headquarters, with Jingjiang as the seat of government, while still maintaining a branch office at Yongzhou.
s0343.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched with provincial officials to transfer and assign officials of rank six and below in distant regions; the Left and Right Two Rivers pacification commissioner's headquarters and assuagement commissions were combined as the Guangxi Two Rivers Circuit pacification commissioner's headquarters, with Jingjiang as the seat of government, while still maintaining a branch office at Yongzhou.

s0344.literal: An order: "All who submit sealed memorials shall have the central secretariat break the seal and examine them, then report upward.
s0344.idiomatic: An order: "All who submit sealed memorials shall have the central secretariat break the seal and examine them, then report upward.

s0345.literal: " An edict ordered monks of Hexi to pay land tax.
s0345.idiomatic: An edict ordered monks of Hexi to pay land tax.

s0346.literal: On guihai day a Mongol Army Commander-in-chief's Headquarters was established in Sichuan, directly subordinate to the military council; Alatiamuer and Yuelehan were both made commanders-in-chief, bearing tiger tallies.
s0346.idiomatic: On guihai day a Mongol Army commander-in-chief's headquarters was established in Sichuan, directly subordinate to the military council; Alatiamuer and Yuelehan were both made commanders-in-chief, bearing tiger tallies.

s0347.literal: The Hexi Longbei Circuit surveillance commission investigated lawbreaking by Commander Zhang; Prince Xiping Aoluchi obstructed the matter; the Emperor ordered him instructed.
s0347.idiomatic: The Hexi Longbei Circuit surveillance commission investigated lawbreaking by Commander Zhang; Prince Xiping Aoluchi obstructed the matter; the Emperor ordered him instructed.

s0348.literal: On jiazi day, because the wives and children of the campaigning army under Prince Anxi lacked food, two thousand shi of grain were granted.
s0348.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because the wives and children of the campaigning army under Prince Anxi lacked food, 2,000 shi of grain were granted.

s0349.literal: In Zhao, He, Teng, Yong, Li, Quan, Heng, Liu, Ji, Gan, Nan'an, and other places rebellious Yao bandits broke out; because military-civil officials had not defended strictly and had not governed properly, all were demoted in rank.
s0349.idiomatic: In Zhao, He, Teng, Yong, Li, Quan, Heng, Liu, Ji, Gan, Nan'an, and other places rebellious Yao bandits broke out; because military-civil officials had not defended strictly and had not governed properly, all were demoted in rank.

s0350.literal: Consort-prince Jining Prince Manzitai privately executed a convicted man; censorate officials reported his usurpation of authority; an order directed Manzitai be informed.
s0350.idiomatic: Consort-prince Jining Prince Manzitai privately executed a convicted man; censorate officials reported his usurpation of authority; an order directed Manzitai be informed.

s0351.literal: On gengwu day the Western Regions Guard Personal Army Command was established; Mierdijin was made commander.
s0351.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Western Regions Guard personal army command was established; Mierdijin was made commander.

s0352.literal: That month locusts struck Bianliang Route; Li Prefecture and Ga Prefecture suffered plant-lice; Tai'an, Caozhou, and Jining routes had flooding; Gongchang, Huan Prefecture, Qingyang, Yan'an, and Anxi suffered drought.
s0352.idiomatic: That month locusts struck Bianliang Route; Li Prefecture and Ga Prefecture suffered plant-lice; Tai'an, Caozhou, and Jining routes had flooding; Gongchang, Huan Prefecture, Qingyang, Yan'an, and Anxi suffered drought.

s0353.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yihai day: more than five hundred artisan households of Gan and Liang were relocated to Xiangyang.
s0353.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, yihai day: more than 500 artisan households of Gan and Liang were relocated to Xiangyang.

s0354.literal: An edict ordered Jiangnan land tax paid in notes.
s0354.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jiangnan land tax paid in notes.

s0355.literal: On dingchou day the moon transgressed Neck.
s0355.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon transgressed Neck.

s0356.literal: Pursuit of already remitted overdue debts was halted.
s0356.idiomatic: Pursuit of already remitted overdue debts was halted.

s0357.literal: Princess Puyan Qielimishi and others, all reporting their divisions impoverished, were granted notes totaling more than four hundred ninety thousand ingots.
s0357.idiomatic: Princess Puyan Qielimishi and others, all reporting their divisions impoverished, were granted notes totaling more than 490,000 ingots.

s0358.literal: Censorate officials said: "Bandits breaking out within the interior are numerous, all because of state amnesties; we request the central secretariat establish regulations and supervise subordinates to eliminate them by the deadline.
s0358.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Bandits breaking out within the interior are numerous, all because of state amnesties; we request the central secretariat establish regulations and supervise subordinates to eliminate them by the deadline.

s0360.literal: On yimao day an edict reiterated instructions throughout the realm: "Those competent in both Confucian learning and administration shall be recommended by each route; each surveillance commission circuit shall annually present two persons; provincial and censorate officials shall be delegated to establish law and conduct examinations — those meeting the standard shall be employed; if presentations are unfair, the presenters shall be punished.
s0360.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict reiterated instructions throughout the realm: "Those competent in both Confucian learning and administration shall be recommended by each route; each surveillance commission circuit shall annually present two persons; provincial and censorate officials shall be delegated to establish law and conduct examinations — those meeting the standard shall be employed; if presentations are unfair, the presenters shall be punished.

s0361.literal: Officials convicted of corruption on first offense would on re-offense receive two degrees heavier punishment.
s0361.idiomatic: Officials convicted of corruption on first offense would on re-offense receive two degrees heavier punishment.

s0362.literal: Treasury officials stealing guarded money and grain: below one string, flogging; up to ten strings, beating; at twenty strings ten additional degrees; at one hundred twenty strings penal servitude one year; each thirty strings adds half a year; at two hundred forty strings penal servitude three years; at three hundred strings, death.
s0362.idiomatic: Treasury officials stealing guarded money and grain: below one string, flogging; up to ten strings, beating; at 20 strings ten additional degrees; at 120 strings penal servitude one year; each 30 strings adds half a year; at 240 strings penal servitude three years; at 300 strings, death.

s0363.literal: Stolen value was calculated by Zhoyuan notes as standard.
s0363.idiomatic: Stolen value was calculated by Zhoyuan notes as standard.

s0364.literal: " One hundred guard troops were granted to the Jiangnan branch censorate.
s0364.idiomatic: One hundred guard troops were granted to the Jiangnan branch censorate.

s0365.literal: Half the Hainan garrison-farm troops were reduced and returned to their original wings.
s0365.idiomatic: Half the Hainan garrison-farm troops were reduced and returned to their original wings.

s0366.literal: An edict ordered increased payment for medicines furnished to the various armies.
s0366.idiomatic: An edict ordered increased payment for medicines furnished to the various armies.

s0367.literal: On renwu day the Zhaozhou Garrison-farm Ten-thousand-household Office was established; Asan, left vice chancellor of Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, was placed in charge.
s0367.idiomatic: On renwu day the Zhaozhou garrison-farm ten-thousand-household office was established; Asan, left vice chancellor of Liaoyang branch secretariat, was placed in charge.

s0368.literal: On jiashen day Jupiter transgressed Room.
s0368.idiomatic: On jiashen day Jupiter transgressed Room.

s0369.literal: Twenty-four thousand ingots of notes were granted to impoverished commoners on the frontier.
s0369.idiomatic: 24,000 ingots of notes were granted to impoverished commoners on the frontier.

s0370.literal: On jichou day Liu Guojie was granted a jade belt and brocade robes to commend his battle merit.
s0370.idiomatic: On jichou day Liu Guojie was granted a jade belt and brocade robes to commend his battle merit.

s0371.literal: On xinmao day, because Tutuhe's division was impoverished, one hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0371.idiomatic: On xinmao day, because Tutuhe's division was impoverished, 100,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0372.literal: On wuxu day Zhu Yongfu and Bian Zhenyu were executed for seditious speech.
s0372.idiomatic: On wuxu day Zhu Yongfu and Bian Zhenyu were executed for seditious speech.

s0373.literal: Zarluchi's documents had formerly used Mongolian; an order directed they now use Chinese characters.
s0373.idiomatic: Zarluchi's documents had formerly used Mongolian; an order directed they now use Chinese characters.

s0374.literal: On renyin day an edict ordered Tianqing Temples on Jiangnan routes renamed Xuanmiao Temples and the spirit tablets of Song Taizu they enshrined destroyed.
s0374.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict ordered Tianqing Temples on Jiangnan routes renamed Xuanmiao Temples and the spirit tablets of Song Taizu they enshrined destroyed.

s0375.literal: Dadu, Liaodong, Dongping, Changde, and Huzhou Military Guard garrison farms suffered major flooding; Longxing Route hail; Taiyuan, Pingyang, Anfeng, Hejian, and other routes drought.
s0375.idiomatic: Dadu, Liaodong, Dongping, Changde, and Huzhou Military Guard garrison farms suffered major flooding; Longxing Route hail; Taiyuan, Pingyang, Anfeng, Hejian, and other routes drought.

s0376.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou day the moon transgressed Ox.
s0376.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou day the moon transgressed Ox.

s0377.literal: On renzi day the moon transgressed Encampment.
s0377.idiomatic: On renzi day the moon transgressed Encampment.

s0378.literal: On xinyou day Burma presented three trained elephants.
s0378.idiomatic: On xinyou day Burma presented three trained elephants.

s0379.literal: On guihai day two months' grain was issued to relieve Liaoyang commoners affected by flooding.
s0379.idiomatic: On guihai day two months' grain was issued to relieve Liaoyang commoners affected by flooding.

s0380.literal: On jisi day consort-prince Nawo was made director of the military council.
s0380.idiomatic: On jisi day consort-prince Nawo was made director of the military council.

s0381.literal: Jin and Fu Prefecture garrison farms had insects eating grain; Bianliang, Anxi, Zhending, and other routes drought; Pingjiang, Anfeng, and other routes major flooding.
s0381.idiomatic: Jin and Fu Prefecture garrison farms had insects eating grain; Bianliang, Anxi, Zhending, and other routes drought; Pingjiang, Anfeng, and other routes major flooding.

s0382.literal: In the ninth month, on jiaxu day the Emperor arrived from Shangdu.
s0382.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiaxu day the Emperor arrived from Shangdu.

s0383.literal: On yihai day, at the imperial preceptor's request, three persons sentenced to death and forty-seven sentenced to beating or lesser punishments were released.
s0383.idiomatic: On yihai day, at the imperial preceptor's request, three persons sentenced to death and 47 sentenced to beating or lesser punishments were released.

s0384.literal: On wuyin day, because Basar was building a private residence, ten thousand yin of salt was granted.
s0384.idiomatic: On wuyin day, because Basar was building a private residence, 10,000 yin of salt was granted.

s0385.literal: An edict ordered one hundred thousand shi of rice transported to former monopoly granaries to supply the northern frontier.
s0385.idiomatic: An edict ordered 100,000 shi of rice transported to former monopoly granaries to supply the northern frontier.

s0386.literal: Because tamachi soldiers were disturbing the people wherever they went, Hebo was ordered to supervise them; offenders' commanding officers would be punished.
s0386.idiomatic: Because tamachi soldiers were disturbing the people wherever they went, Hebo was ordered to supervise them; offenders' commanding officers would be punished.

s0387.literal: On yimao day four thousand gold-washing households in Sichuan were abolished and returned to their original registers; those who first proposed the scheme were punished.
s0387.idiomatic: On yimao day 4,000 gold-washing households in Sichuan were abolished and returned to their original registers; those who first proposed the scheme were punished.

s0388.literal: On gengchen day the Ningxia Route branch secretariat was abolished and its affairs merged into Gansu Branch Secretariat.
s0388.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Ningxia Route branch secretariat was abolished and its affairs merged into Gansu branch secretariat.

s0389.literal: On dinghai day Java dispatched envoys presenting tribute.
s0389.idiomatic: On dinghai day Java dispatched envoys presenting tribute.

s0390.literal: On jichou day one thousand shi of grain was granted to armorers of Huanzhou.
s0390.idiomatic: On jichou day 1,000 shi of grain was granted to armorers of Huanzhou.

s0391.literal: On renchen day Guo Qi, jail warden of Huzhou, accused Zhexi Surveillance Commission Vice Commissioner Zhang Xiaosi of taking excessive salary rations; Xiaosi imprisoned Qi.
s0391.idiomatic: On renchen day Guo Qi, jail warden of Huzhou, accused Zhexi surveillance commission vice commissioner Zhang Xiaosi of taking excessive salary rations; Xiaosi imprisoned Qi.

s0392.literal: The branch censorate ordered investigating censor Yang Ren to conduct the inquiry; Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat grand councillor Temur had Xiaosi brought to the secretariat for questioning and also ordered his subordinates to join Ren in questioning Qi; Ren refused; the branch censorate reported upward.
s0392.idiomatic: The branch censorate ordered investigating censor Yang Ren to conduct the inquiry; Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat grand councillor Temur had Xiaosi brought to the secretariat for questioning and also ordered his subordinates to join Ren in questioning Qi; Ren refused; the branch censorate reported upward.

s0393.literal: An edict ordered secretariat and censorate officials dispatched to investigate; after confessing, all were beaten.
s0393.idiomatic: An edict ordered secretariat and censorate officials dispatched to investigate; after confessing, all were beaten.

s0394.literal: The households of Prince Xiaoxie were disturbing the people; officials were dispatched to investigate; the more serious offenders were beaten; the rest were left to Xiaoxie to punish.
s0394.idiomatic: The households of Prince Xiaoxie were disturbing the people; officials were dispatched to investigate; the more serious offenders were beaten; the rest were left to Xiaoxie to punish.

s0395.literal: On jiawu day the moon transgressed Chariot.
s0395.idiomatic: On jiawu day the moon transgressed Chariot.

s0396.literal: On wuxu day the moon transgressed Flat Road.
s0396.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon transgressed Flat Road.

s0397.literal: Xuande Prefecture suffered major flooding; military and civilians lacked food; two months' grain was granted.
s0397.idiomatic: Xuande Prefecture suffered major flooding; military and civilians lacked food; two months' grain was granted.

s0398.literal: Wanying garrison of the Military Guard and Yan'an Route — frost killed grain; Gaoyou Prefecture, Si Prefecture, and He Prefecture drought; Pingjiang, Luzhou, and other routes major flooding.
s0398.idiomatic: Wanying garrison of the Military Guard and Yan'an Route — frost killed grain; Gaoyou Prefecture, Si Prefecture, and He Prefecture drought; Pingjiang, Luzhou, and other routes major flooding.

s0399.literal: Winter, tenth month, guimao day: sacrifices were performed at the imperial ancestral temple.
s0399.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, guimao day: sacrifices were performed at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0400.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Last year when Emperor Shizu, the empress, and Prince Yuzong were enshrined in the temple, silk was used in place of jade registers.
s0400.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Last year when Emperor Shizu, the empress, and Prince Yuzong were enshrined in the temple, silk was used in place of jade registers.
